Prerequisites Wandering Chef Dedication, Flash Cook

You have learned to turn whatever is on the table into a weapon, and to throw it the moment it leaves the pan.

Flash Cook and Strike When you use Flash Cook, you can Strike with the Food Projectile it creates as part of the same action. This Strike counts toward your multiple attack penalty as normal.

Deadlier and farther The Food Projectiles you create with Flash Cook gain the deadly d8 trait, so on a critical hit they deal an extra d8 damage after the damage is doubled. Their range also increases from 10 feet to 15 feet.

Module With this feat on a character, the Flash Cook action makes the deadlier projectile and offers the Strike. It can be switched off in the module settings under Wandering Chef.
